paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Kamigawa (alternatively Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Alchemy ) is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set that was released on March 17, 2022. It is the second set in the Alchemy -series.

Alchemy: Kamigawa is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty . There are 30 new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (5 uncommons, 20 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on Kamigawa .
As with all previous Alchemy cards , the cards of this set had the MTG Arena "A" as a " foil stamp " at the central bottom of the card. The set also features the A22 expansion symbol .

The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Perpetually and Seek that were introduced in Jumpstart: Historic Horizons all return in this set. The Spellbook mechanic from Alchemy: Innistrad also sees a return. Apart from that, there are also random effects influencing cards in your hand (e.g. Foundry Beetle ) or library (e.g. Junkyard Scrapper ).
The set introduces the Intensity mechanic, a form of perpetually marking numerical values on a card.

paragraphs.text: A new event, Into the Future , was held on Arena from March 17 to 19, 2022. There were four preconstructed Alchemy decks available to play, each showcasing new cards from Alchemy: Kamigawa .
